title: Software Engineer
description:
As a Software Engineer on the sBTC team at Stacks Labs , you'll help build sBTC - a 1:1 Bitcoin-backed asset that brings BTC into smart contracts, secured by a decentralized network of signers.

You'll operate autonomously in a fully remote role, collaborating with a talented, globally distributed team to design and implement the protocol, signer software, and tooling that move Bitcoin in and out of the Stacks blockchain. This is a hands-on engineering role with real ownership over some of the most critical, security-sensitive infrastructure in the Stacks ecosystem.

Outcomes You'll Drive

•
A secure, correct peg between Bitcoin and Stacks
Deposits and withdrawals move real Bitcoin reliably and safely, backed by threshold-signing coordination that holds up under adversarial and edge-case conditions, not just the happy path.

•
Signer software that performs under real-world conditions
The sBTC signer network stays healthy, observable, and resilient in the presence of faults, network partitions, and delays - because it's securing real Bitcoin, not test funds.

•
Tooling that makes sBTC easier to build on, monitor, and debug
CLI clients, monitoring utilities, and benchmarking tools give internal teams and external partners clear visibility into signer health and peg operations, reducing the time it takes to diagnose and resolve issues.

•
A codebase built for scale and change
Strong engineering fundamentals - scalable architecture, disciplined refactoring, thorough testing - mean the sBTC protocol can absorb new features and integrations without accumulating risk.

What You'll Do

Core sBTC Protocol Engineering

• Contribute to developing, maintaining, and testing the sBTC protocol and its signer software.

• Design and implement core peg mechanics - deposits and withdrawals - and the threshold-signing coordination that secures the sBTC wallet.

• Implement rigorous and thorough monitoring and testing to meet the stringent security and performance requirements of a system safeguarding real Bitcoin.

• Design and implement supporting tools and utilities, such as CLI clients, applications that support moving sBTC on or off the Stacks blockchain, and utilities for monitoring signer health, benchmarking, or debugging.

• Collaborate with other teams on new product features across the Stacks blockchain, including applications that support moving sBTC on or off the Stacks blockchain and protocol integrations.

• Work closely with internal teams and external partners, communicating design decisions and trade-offs clearly as sBTC integrates with new products and partner systems.

What We're Looking For

•
5+ years of experience building and shipping products.

•
Strong, demonstrated engineering fundamentals , including scalability, architecture, refactoring, algorithms, and testing.

• Experience building and operating security- or reliability-critical backend systems.

•
Strong written and verbal communication skills , with the ability to work effectively with both internal teams and external partners.

Nice to Have

• Expertise in Rust, which is the primary language of the sBTC codebase.

• Working knowledge of blockchains, distributed systems, peer-to-peer systems, and decentralization.

• Familiarity with the Bitcoin protocol.

• Knowledge of multi-party cryptography.

• Experience testing distributed systems for behaviors in the presence of faults, network partitions, and network delays.

What We Offer

• Competitive compensation including $160,000-$200,000 USD base salary.

• Stacks (STX) tokens - STX is the native cryptocurrency of the Stacks network.

• Comprehensive health coverage and free life and disability insurance.

• Up to 16 weeks of paid parental leave to support you through one of life's biggest transitions.

• Monthly stipends for your home office or co-working space of choice.

• Annual learning and development stipend to keep growing your skills.

title: Associate, GTM Operations
description:
ABOUT RAMP

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year - far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Ramp is building a more intelligent, scalable go-to-market engine. As an Associate on the GTM Operations team, you’ll combine analytical rigor with hands-on process design, systems thinking, and AI-enabled automation to help our GTM teams execute more effectively.

You’ll work directly with GTM leaders and cross-functional partners to identify performance gaps, turn insights into operating improvements, and build repeatable workflows that scale. This is a high-velocity individual contributor role with broad ownership: you’ll define problems, build solutions, and measure their impact.

Your primary focus will be defined by the team you support, with shared standards and close partnership across Strategic Finance, Growth Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, GTM Systems, and Data.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Lead cross-functional projects beyond these core operating areas, taking ambiguous problems through implementation, stakeholder adoption, and impact measurement.

- Diagnose pipeline, conversion, and rep-execution gaps; partner with leaders to prioritize interventions and measure their impact.

- Partner with GTM leaders to improve segmentation, account books, and territory design, aligning coverage with customer needs and team capacity.

- Strengthen attribution definitions, logic, and data quality so leaders can reliably connect GTM activities to outcomes.

- Partner with Product and Growth to enhance sales tools that improve rep efficiency and coverage.

WHAT YOU NEED

- 2-4 years of relevant experience in GTM Strategy and Operations, Management Consulting, Investment Banking, or similar analytical role, preferably in a high-growth technology environment

- Demonstrated ability to turn insights into scalable processes, systems, and automation, owning execution from design through rollout and delivering measurable gains in adoption, productivity, and GTM performance.

- Exceptional verbal and written communication skills; ability to explain analytical findings, recommend a course of action, and align stakeholders.

- The ability to prioritize high-leverage work, manage multiple projects, and follow through from a loosely defined problem to a reliable operating solution.

NICE-TO-HAVES

- Ability to partner across Sales, Finance, Product, and post-sale teams to support multiple GTM motions in a multiproduct business, translating shared priorities into clear decisions, coordinated execution, and measurable results.

- Familiarity with product-led, usage-based, or consumption-driven GTM motions.

- Demonstrated ability to drive adoption of new tools and processes through documentation, enablement, and change management.

- Hands-on experience with Salesforce and a BI platform such as Looker, including familiarity with CRM data structures, funnel reporting, and data-quality controls.

- Flexible PTO

- Centralized home-office equipment ordering

- Budget for intra-office travel
